title: Engineer - NPI & Engineering (ECN & Component Obsolescence Management)
Creo Design Engineers
qualification: BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
other_details: Key Responsibilities: Develop 3D models, assemblies, and detailed manufacturing drawings using Creo Parametric. Interpret engineering specifications, design requirements, and technical documentation. Perform design modifications and implement engineering change requests. Ensure CAD data quality and adherence to design standards. Support BOM creation and drawing release activities. Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, and Project Management teams. Participate in design reviews and incorporate feedback effectively. Required Skills: Strong proficiency in Creo Parametric. Good understanding of GD&T and engineering drawing practices. Knowledge of product design and manufacturing processes. Experience in part modeling, assembly design, and detailing. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good to Have: Experience with SolidWorks, Solid Edge, or Siemens NX. Immediate joiners.
